comments.body:
Mechanism and measurements (investigation before claim).

Decision rule: `pass3_decide` in src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py returns `dropped / veto:cited-reference-inaccurate` whenever the Pass-2 binary `cited_reference_accurate == "no"`. It compares no locations. The verifier prompts decide what that answer means, and neither says whose citation is in question: the agentic prompt says "for a finding that cites a specific code reference, VERIFY the citation"; the single-turn prompt says "answer it only when the finding cites a specific code reference".

Sidecar evidence: the 5 dropped findings on this ticket (28d0-148d f49e9d9ad9502c56e; c159-1621 fcf9e907f6cdeeee1, feb2e8e8f9645fdf2; 2a3d-9d00 fc278276e288565ef, f760ac2553d5604cd) all carry cited_reference_accurate=no together with evidence_entails_finding=yes and validity 0.67-1.0. Store-wide across 9,757 saved REVIEW_RESULT sidecars the veto fired 1,489 times; 448 of those had evidence_entails_finding=yes and 519 had validity >= 0.5.

Reproduction: scratch probe running the real Pass-2 prompt through the kernel verify_findings + pass3_decide, configured standard model (bedrock sonnet-4-6), agentic runs inside a local gate_read_root session. Fixture: plan with case 1 (nonexistent tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py), case 2 (CHANGELOG.md:371) and case 4 (AGENTS.md:215) mis-citations, 3 correct findings reporting them, plus a control whose OWN evidence cites src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:40-41 for AUTHOR_GUIDES (wrong).

Unfixed prompts, 3 samples each:
- agentic: runs where all 3 correct findings survived = 0/3 (7 of 9 correct-finding verdicts were cra=no -> vetoed); control vetoed 3/3.
- single-turn: all 3 survived in 1/3 runs (4 of 9 vetoed).

Scoped prompts (rule: the question tests the finding's own evidence; a wrong plan citation the finding reports is yes, never no), 3 samples each:
- agentic: all 3 survived 3/3 runs (9/9 cra=yes); control vetoed 3/3 (cra=no).
- single-turn: all 3 survived 3/3 (cra=insufficient or na, none vetoed); control cra=no in 2/3, dropped in 3/3.

Prior intent: epic messy-moose-jig and evals/plan-review-gate/harnesses/three_pass.py aim Pass-2 skepticism at the FINDING and scope the veto to a code citation present in the finding's evidence. Nothing documents vetoing a finding because the plan's citation is wrong. Code fix scope: the two prompts + the docs sentence, no change to pass3_decide.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

The plan-review Pass-3 veto `veto:cited-reference-inaccurate` (`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py`, `pass3_decide`) drops a finding whenever the Pass-2 verifier answers `cited_reference_accurate == "no"`. That rule is deterministic and compares no locations; the defect is in the question the verifier is asked. Neither plan-review verifier prompt says whose citation the question is about. When a finding's claim is that the PLAN's citation is wrong, the verifier checks the plan's citation, finds it wrong, and answers `no`, so the gate drops the finding exactly when it is correct.

Evidence: all 5 drops reported on this ticket carry `cited_reference_accurate: "no"` with `evidence_entails_finding: "yes"` in their saved `REVIEW_RESULT` sidecars. Measured verifier behaviour (3 samples per arm) is in the ticket comments.

## Prior intent

Epic messy-moose-jig and `evals/plan-review-gate/harnesses/three_pass.py` aim Pass-2 skepticism at the FINDING and scope the veto to "a code citation present" in the finding's evidence. Nothing documents vetoing a finding because the plan's citation is wrong. The fix restores that purpose.

## Approach

1. In `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier_agentic.md`, replace the paragraph beginning "cited_reference_accurate is yes|no|insufficient|na — for a finding that cites a specific code reference, VERIFY the citation with read_file/search_files" with one that keeps the read_file/search_files instruction and adds: the question tests the finding's OWN evidence references; `no` means the finding's evidence does not show what the finding says and vetoes it; a reference the PLAN makes is not the finding's citation, so a finding that correctly reports a wrong plan citation is `yes`, never `no`; a corrected location the finding offers is judged as its own evidence.
2. In `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md` (single-turn, no tools), replace the paragraph beginning "cited_reference_accurate is yes|no|insufficient|na — answer it only when the finding cites a specific code reference, else na" with the same scoping, without the tool instruction.
3. In `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, change the decision-rule sentence "the only veto is `cited_reference_accurate == "no"` (fires only when a finding cites a specific code reference)" to say it fires when the finding's OWN cited reference is refuted, not when the finding reports a wrong plan citation.
4. Add `tests/external/test_cited_reference_veto_scope_live.py`, parametrized over both verifier prompts. Fixture: a plan with two wrong citations (nonexistent `tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py`; `AGENTS.md:215`), two correct findings reporting them, and a control finding whose own evidence cites a wrong location. Per variant, by majority of 3 runs (measured margin: 3/3 on the fixed prompts for both variants; 0/3 agentic and 1/3 single-turn on the unfixed prompts, recorded in a comment): no plan-citation finding is vetoed or unverified. For the agentic variant the control must also be vetoed (the single-turn verifier has no tools to read the control's lines). The kernel enforces verifier prompt rules behaviorally rather than by prompt-text greps (`review_kernel/verify.py`), so this test lives in the external live tier.

No change to `pass3_decide`, Pass-2 verifier variance handling, or cross-criterion grouping.

`code-review-verify.md` has the same unscoped wording and feeds the same veto, but it is a separate gate whose verdicts live with the review-bot, and no code-review drop of this shape has been measured. Changing it without that measurement would alter every Gerrit `LLM-Review` vote on untested behaviour. It is filed as asthmatic-bemused-wyvern (linked `discovered_from`), which measures code-review drops first and applies the same scoping if any are found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A ticket comment records the veto's decision rule from `pass3_decide` and the sidecar evidence that prompt wording, not a location comparison, made it fire.
- [x] The agentic verifier prompt carries the scoped `cited_reference_accurate` rule.
- [x] The single-turn verifier prompt carries the scoped `cited_reference_accurate` rule.
- [x] `docs/plan-review-gate.md`'s decision-rule sentence states the veto fires on the finding's own refuted citation.
- [x] The live test passes for both variants on the fixed prompts.
- [x] The live test fails for both variants on the unfixed prompts (measured, recorded in a comment).
- [x] One `review-plan` on a throwaway ticket carrying the case-2 mis-citation (`CHANGELOG.md:371` for the v0.12.0 `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` removal) is run after the fix, and its result is recorded in a comment with the sidecar reason for the citation finding.
- [x] A comment maps all 5 recorded cases to the fix: cases 1, 2 and 4 are reproduced in the fixture or throwaway review; cases 3 and 5 share their shape.
- [x] `make lint` passes.
- [x] `make typecheck` passes.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py tests/unit/test_plan_review.py` passes.

## Testing
`pytest tests/unit/test_criteria_vocabulary_reviewers.py tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py tests/unit/test_plan_review.py`; `REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 pytest -m external tests/external/test_cited_reference_veto_scope_live.py` (needs provider credentials).
